title: Enhancing Mixed Oil Length Prediction through Graph Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: During the pipeline transportation of refined oil products, the inevitable formation of mixed oil segments poses considerable economic challenges to pipeline networks. Therefore, it is important to accurately predict the length of these mixed oil segments. Although previous methods have achieved relatively accurate predictions by integrating machine and deep learning algorithms, they ignore the statistical dependencies that remain among real-world mixed oil samples, which degrades model accuracy. To address this issue, we propose a novel Sample Dependencies Incorporated Graph Representation Learning (SDI-GRL) model. By representing samples and pipeline features as nodes of a graph, SDI-GRL connects dependent samples through their shared features, allowing message passing to propagate information across related samples. This graph-based framework allows our model to capture the statistical dependencies among samples absent in prior works.

translated_title: 基于图表示学习的混油段长度预测增强方法
translated_abstract: 在成品油管道运输过程中，不可避免形成的混油段给管道网络带来了巨大的经济挑战。因此，准确预测这些混油段的长度至关重要。尽管先前的方法通过结合机器学习和深度学习算法已实现相对准确的预测，但它们忽略了现实世界中混油样本之间依然存在的统计依赖性，从而降低了模型精度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的样本依赖性融合图表示学习（SDI-GRL）模型。通过将样本和管道特征表示为图中的节点，SDI-GRL通过共享特征连接相互依赖的样本，使消息传递能够在相关样本之间传播信息。这种基于图的框架使我们的模型能够捕捉到先前工作所忽略的样本间统计依赖性。
tldr: 该论文提出SDI-GRL模型，通过将混油样本和管道特征构建为图节点并利用消息传递机制，捕捉样本间的统计依赖性，从而显著提升成品油管道运输中混油段长度的预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the SDI-GRL model, which represents mixed oil samples and pipeline features as graph nodes with message passing to capture statistical dependencies among samples, thereby improving the accuracy of mixed oil segment length prediction in refined oil pipeline transportation.
